pages.title: Duotrace
pages.creator: Duotrace
pages.description: Duotrace challenges you to draw through a shape without breaking contact, tracing every line exactly twice. Choose connected nodes in an order that leaves a workable route. Use limited hints or restart when your path cannot complete the double-tracing requirement.

pages.title: High School Teacher Games Life
pages.creator: CodesXpirit
pages.description: High School Teacher Games Life gives you a school day to explore through career, mission, and quiz modes. Move around, interact with the available activities, and handle teaching-related tasks. Choose between following the teacher's routine and taking on individual classroom challenges.

pages.title: Park Me: Draw Path
pages.creator: HolaStudio
pages.description: Park Me: Draw Path asks you to sketch a route from a car to its assigned parking space. Once the line is drawn, the vehicle follows it automatically. Plan paths that reach their destinations without colliding with other cars in the layout.

pages.title: Maido
pages.creator: Mofu Module
pages.description: Maido has you run a shop by producing items, merging matching goods, and negotiating sales. Improve items into higher tiers before offering them to customers. Set prices carefully: a low price reduces profit, while an excessive one can lose the sale.

pages.title: Besties Chinese New Year Celebration
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Besties Chinese New Year Celebration lets you prepare a group of friends for the Lunar New Year. Choose traditional outfits, modern fashions, and festive accessories for their celebration. Combine the wardrobe pieces to give each bestie her own holiday appearance.

pages.title: Toy Rumble 3d
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Toy Rumble 3d sends a toy tank through an obstacle-course race. Collect parts along the route to build its cannon, then use the assembled weapon to shoot your way forward. Guide the vehicle through the course while preparing it for battle.

pages.title: Dear Island
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Dear Island asks you to clear blocks in pairs matching the current Match Slot's color. Store differently colored pieces temporarily while planning your next pair. Empty the stage without allowing the Stock area to fill with blocks you cannot yet use.

pages.title: Match Tile Royal Family
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Match Tile Royal Family combines matching-tile puzzles with rescuing a royal family from traps. Select tiles sharing the same design to remove them and work through the board. Complete the matching challenges to unlock later levels and continue the royal rescue.

pages.title: Froggy Hop
pages.creator: Dissorto
pages.description: Froggy Hop challenges you to launch a frog and keep it bouncing across lily pads, turtles, and spring pads. Time dives to land on useful surfaces and extend the distance. Upgrade jumping strength, height, and bounce between attempts to improve future launches.

pages.title: Space Survival Rainbow Friends Monster
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Space Survival Rainbow Friends Monster puts you in a space station occupied by hostile rainbow creatures. Shoot the attacking waves while dodging their return attacks. Fight your way toward escape and help rescue the friends trapped in the station with you.

pages.title: NSR Street Car Racing
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: NSR Street Car Racing offers multiplayer street races and one-on-one driving duels. Customize a car, control its drifts, and use nitro to gain speed. Compete against other drivers while handling corners and managing acceleration through the street-racing courses.

pages.title: Pizza Tycoon
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Pizza Tycoon puts you in charge of Boss Hei Wa's pizza business. Serve customers, take their payments, and hire staff to keep the shop operating. Improve employees and expand sales channels as you grow the restaurant beyond its starting setup.

pages.title: Memory Wars
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Memory Wars uses paired cards to turn a memory challenge into a battle. Flip tiles to search for matches, spending energy with each reveal. Matching cards damage the enemy, so remembering earlier choices helps you defeat opponents before your resources are exhausted.

pages.title: Gluttony
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Gluttony puts a hungry hole under your control and asks you to swallow objects to grow. Move around collecting everything safe to eat while avoiding small monsters. Those creatures are dangerous to the hole, so steer clear of them during the feeding spree.

pages.title: Real Car Parking And Stunt
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Real Car Parking And Stunt offers separate challenges for accurate parking and stunt driving. Choose a mode and guide the car through the level's demands. Practice controlled positioning in parking tasks or handle the vehicle's movement through more spectacular stunt sections.

pages.title: Shelf Shift Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shelf Shift Match challenges you to rearrange shelf items into groups of three. Clear matches to uncover shadowed objects behind them, while keeping enough room to continue shifting. Use a shuffle when stuck rather than leaving the shelves blocked with unusable arrangements.

pages.title: Skating Park
pages.creator: Freezers Games
pages.description: Skating Park combines skateboard racing with ramps, shortcuts, and contact between opponents. Steer across the course, knock rivals off their path, and jump to another track when a shortcut appears. Find a fast route while keeping your skater in the race.

pages.title: Doomsday Zombie TD
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Doomsday Zombie TD tasks you with protecting a castle from attacking undead forces. Arrange your defense and improve buildings, towers, weapons, and troops as the battles continue. Use those upgrades to strengthen the army holding back each advancing zombie assault.

pages.title: Backrooms Skibidi terrors
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Backrooms Skibidi terrors challenges you to escape while a Skibidi Toilet threatens the maze-like setting. Run through the environment, collect coins, and avoid the pursuing danger. Crouch when necessary as you look for a way to survive and leave the backrooms.

pages.title: Idle Lawnmower
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Idle Lawnmower turns mowing grass into an idle earning loop. Cut swaths of lawn to collect gold, then invest the proceeds in improving your mower. Stronger equipment increases the efficiency and earning potential of the next round of grass cutting.

pages.title: Vega Mix: Fairy town
pages.creator: Broccoli Games
pages.description: Vega Mix: Fairy town follows Vika and a magical city's mayor as they restore the New Year celebration. Solve match-three stages to help with the town's problems. Create special pieces such as line-clearing rockets by arranging larger gem combinations.

pages.title: OMG Word Rainbow
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: OMG Word Rainbow challenges you to discover words by linking neighboring letter tiles. Draw a continuous path through the letters to reveal the hidden answers in each colorful puzzle. Keep searching the mosaic for combinations that complete the stage's word list.

pages.title: Merge Fruit Time
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Merge Fruit Time asks you to drop fruit so identical pieces meet and combine. Choose each landing position carefully to keep the stage from filling up. Use a bomb to clear a troublesome area when needed and keep merging toward a higher score.

pages.title: Super Girls Fall Fashion Trends
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Super Girls Fall Fashion Trends gives a group of fashion-loving girls a refreshed autumn wardrobe. Browse their new clothing and choose pieces for the season. Build coordinated outfits for the super girls as you explore the fall styling options available to each one.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter World Cup
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Bubble Shooter World Cup turns national-team footballs into a bubble-matching puzzle. Aim a ball to form a group of at least three bearing the same flag. Pop the matching cluster and continue clearing the arrangement with carefully placed shots.

pages.title: Idle island
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Idle island sends you on a rescue mission across an island held by your enemy. Gather resources, build bridges, and open routes to new areas. Win the battles along the way as you work toward freeing the captured princess.

pages.title: COLORFUL ASSORT
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: COLORFUL ASSORT asks you to transfer bottle contents until matching types are grouped together. Pick up a portion and place it into a compatible bottle with room available. You cannot mix unlike types or add to a full container, so preserve useful space.

pages.title: Basketball Challenge
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Basketball Challenge gives you swipe-controlled shooting in two modes. In Single mode, make every shot to reach the next level; in Endless mode, the attempt ends after three misses. Adjust each throw as you try to improve your scoring run.

pages.title: Traffic Control Math
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Traffic Control Math makes arithmetic answers control a busy junction. Solve the problems associated with each signal to turn its light green and keep vehicles moving. Beat the time limit without congestion, since a wrong answer ends the traffic-control attempt.

pages.title: Angry Heroes
pages.creator: BestGamesDevelopers
pages.description: Angry Heroes uses a slingshot to launch attacks at aliens and their shelters. Aim your shots and use special powers to destroy the structures protecting the enemies. Work through the stages, defeat bosses, and unlock further power-ups for the small heroes.

pages.title: Stickman Parkour
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Stickman Parkour sends a stick figure running and jumping across platforming courses. Time your leaps and perform tricks while navigating the space available for maneuvers. Keep moving quickly as you attempt to complete more stages of the parkour challenge.

pages.title: Moon Mission
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Moon Mission has you direct an astronaut gathering resources across several planets. Mine with your lunar base, invest in upgrades, and launch a rocket to explore farther. Discover stars and travel through a wormhole as your space operation expands.

pages.title: The Utans
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: The Utans puts you in charge of defending Mavas against invading enemies across twelve stages. Position troops at fixed sites and collect fruit to recruit more or improve towers. Strengthen the defenses as you work to stop attackers reaching the base.

pages.title: Find The Trumpet
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Find The Trumpet is an escape-style search about recovering a girl's missing musical instrument before her lesson. Explore the setting, examine clues, and solve the puzzles that block the search. Use what you discover to locate the lost trumpet in time.

pages.title: Beach Crazy
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Beach Crazy gives you buggies and boats for destructive stunt courses. Use rocket boosts, missiles, and crash bombs to keep moving even when the vehicle loses its normal mobility. Collect every stunt reel and smash scenery to unlock the next stage.

pages.title: Thor King Pig 2
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Thor King Pig 2 follows an axe-throwing hero trying to reach the exit in his fight against the pig king. Gather diamonds along the way while avoiding enemy soldiers. Move quickly toward the doorway and avoid staying underwater long enough to drown.

pages.title: Pop It Fun Bang Bang
pages.creator: Lazy Bird Games
pages.description: Pop It Fun Bang Bang offers one hundred different pop-it designs to work through. Click or tap their raised bubbles and continue until the current piece is fully popped. Move between the original shapes as you complete each tactile-style popping activity.

pages.title: City Driver Steal Cars
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: City Driver Steal Cars lets you explore a traffic-filled city and take vehicles to sell from your garage. Search for different car types, including police vehicles, and drive them through the streets. Use nitro, drift, or change cars during the open-world outing.

pages.title: Squid Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Squid Coloring Book gives you twelve character pictures and eleven colors for decorating them. Choose a drawing and apply the shades you want to its different areas. Complete your own version of the picture and save the colored result when finished.

pages.title: Perfect Slices Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Perfect Slices Master asks you to chop vegetables into small pieces for soup. Guide the knife through the food while watching for boards that can damage its cutting ability. Earn coins while slicing and buy additional knife types from the shop.

pages.title: Yellow Ball
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Yellow Ball challenges you to fire a small white ball at a yellow target around a circle. The target can appear at eight positions while the firing direction rotates. Time the launch to line up the shot with its current location.

pages.title: Jump cube
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Jump cube is an endless isometric running game controlled with taps to jump. Keep the character moving through the course while working toward a higher score. Reach the required scoring thresholds to unlock more of the five available characters.

pages.title: Bullet Fury 2
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Bullet Fury 2 puts you in an enemy laboratory after your unit discovers its location. Move through the facility, aim your weapon, and eliminate the guards stationed there. Complete the shooting mission by clearing the laboratory's hostile defenders.

pages.title: Mafia City Driving
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Mafia City Driving lets you select a supercar and take on missions around a detailed city. Drive through its streets, control your speed with the brakes, and choose your preferred camera. Complete the available assignments while exploring the mafia-themed urban setting.

pages.title: Crazy Math
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Crazy Math tests how quickly you can identify correct arithmetic answers. Choose a difficulty and tap the appropriate response to each operation. Try the harder setting for a faster mental-math challenge and work toward the game's fifty-point benchmark.

pages.title: Zombie Assassin
pages.creator: Vedia Games
pages.description: Zombie Assassin has you control a zombie sneaking through rooms occupied by armed soldiers. Tap destinations to approach enemies without being seen, then eliminate every soldier to advance. Spend the money earned from kills on stronger zombie forms and improved abilities.

pages.title: Bowling vs Zombies Factory 3D
pages.creator: mkhinteractive.com
pages.description: Bowling vs Zombies Factory 3D replaces a bowling ball with a cannon defending a bridge. Fire at approaching zombies to knock them into the water before they reach your castle. Hold off the waves by keeping the crossing clear of attackers.

pages.title: Butterflies Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Butterflies Jigsaw offers twelve butterfly pictures with easy, medium, and hard puzzle options. Choose an image and drag the pieces into their correct places. Reconstruct the wings, colors, and surrounding details until the completed butterfly picture is restored.

pages.title: Animal Firetrucks Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Animal Firetrucks Match 3 asks you to form rows of at least three matching pieces. Clear groups to earn points while watching the meter on the left. Keep making matches so the gauge does not fall far enough to end the game.

pages.title: Pinball Football
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Pinball Football combines a football-scoring challenge with pinball-style play. Send the ball toward the goal and try to beat the computer's defense. Score four goals to advance from each stage and work through the full set of twenty levels.

pages.title: Police Bike City Simulator
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Police Bike City Simulator puts you on patrol with a motorcycle in a crime-filled city. Ride through the streets, confront the criminals, and work through the police assignments. Unlock additional superbikes to change the vehicle you use while protecting the city.

pages.title: Sports Mahjong Connection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Sports Mahjong Connection challenges you to remove pairs of tiles bearing matching sports images. A valid connection can bend no more than twice at right angles. Search for available routes between identical tiles until the entire board is cleared.

pages.title: Pizza Ninja Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Pizza Ninja Mania has you slice flying pizza ingredients while entertaining impatient customers. Choose a mode and cut the food in the required way. Trial mode ends after three dropped ingredients, while Queue mode requires attention to the order of customer requests.

pages.title: Late for School Dress Up Game
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Late for School Dress Up Game follows a student who has overslept and needs to get ready quickly. Choose classic school-uniform pieces to create her anime-style appearance. Assemble the outfit before sending the late student off with her toast.

pages.title: Block Hexa Puzzle
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Block Hexa Puzzle gives you shaped pieces to drag into a hexagonal board. Fill every space by finding the arrangement that fits the supplied blocks. Work through more than 240 puzzles as the layouts progress from beginner designs to harder challenges.

pages.title: 2 dots challenge
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: 2 dots challenge asks you to fire colored balls at two rotating red and blue circles. Wait until the matching circle lines up, then shoot before the time allowance expires. Hitting the wrong color or waiting too long ends the attempt.

pages.title: Phew Phew Space Shooter
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Phew Phew Space Shooter pits you against waves of enemies in arenas affected by gravity. Move and fire while accounting for black holes that bend both friendly and hostile projectiles. Adapt your aim to those forces as the next attacking wave appears.

pages.title: Graceful Swans Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Graceful Swans Puzzle features six jigsaws of an anime girl with swans. Choose a picture and select sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces. Match the scattered details to rebuild the scene at the difficulty you prefer.

pages.title: Bestie Face Art
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Bestie Face Art joins Mia and Bella for a weekend makeover centered on painted designs. Create face art inspired by butterflies, flowers, and other decorative themes. Choose outfits for the two friends to accompany the colorful patterns you have given them.

pages.title: Garden Hidden Objects
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Garden Hidden Objects places a list of items beside a garden scene. Search the picture and click each object as you find it. Complete the requested collection before the timer runs out to receive the level's time-based bonus.

pages.title: Solitaire : zen earth edition
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Solitaire : zen earth edition presents Klondike card play against nature and city backgrounds. Move cards through the layout and choose between drawing one card or three. Use hints to identify possible moves and customize the visual setting of the game.

pages.title: Reinarte Checkers
pages.creator: Reinarte Games
pages.description: Reinarte Checkers puts an eight-by-eight checkerboard between you and a computer opponent. Choose your color and plan moves that outmaneuver the AI. Work through the familiar board-game contest using the available options and either of its two interface languages.

pages.title: Vegas Crime City
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Vegas Crime City casts you as a gangster moving through a city contested by rival groups. Explore on foot, use different weapons, and take part in street combat. Switch equipment and aim your shots while confronting the enemies in the urban setting.

pages.title: Anime Kawaii School Girls Dress Up
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Anime Kawaii School Girls Dress Up offers six characters and a wardrobe mixing several fashion influences. Try kawaii clothing, everyday European looks, fairy-tale pieces, and futuristic styles. Build an outfit for your anime avatar and capture a picture of the finished look.

pages.title: The Floor is Lava 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: The Floor is Lava 3D challenges you to keep jumping across a living room when its floor can suddenly become dangerous. Move between safe positions and use the available hearts to extend your attempt. Keep the character hopping for as long as possible.

pages.title: Princess Boujee Vs Bummy
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Boujee Vs Bummy has Ariel exchanging her usual princess dresses for two contrasting fashion directions. Explore the boujee and bummy wardrobe choices and decide which look to create. Combine the available clothing into a new summer style for the princess.

pages.title: Death Race Rivals
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Death Race Rivals puts enemy vehicles and attacking helicopters along your driving route. Steer through the road battle and fire to destroy the threats before they take you out. Survive the armed pursuit as you work through the game's levels.

pages.title: Happy Halloween Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Happy Halloween Jigsaw gives you twelve seasonal pictures to reconstruct. Choose an easy 25-piece puzzle, a medium 49-piece version, or a harder hundred-piece layout. Drag the sections together until the full Halloween scene is assembled at your selected difficulty.

pages.title: Lego Superhero Race
pages.creator: Tasty Cherry
pages.description: Lego Superhero Race offers ten racing cars with more than a hundred body parts and color options for customization. Build a vehicle setup, learn the track, and use nitro during races. Unlock more cars while trying to improve the course records.

pages.title: Car Carrier Trailer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Car Carrier Trailer gives you transport-driving missions involving both cars and trucks. Take control of the required vehicle and complete its assignment, switching camera views when useful. Handle the different vehicles as you work through the carrier's sequence of driving jobs.

pages.title: EG Shoot Robbers
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Shoot Robbers challenges you to eliminate the thieves appearing as shooting targets. Aim and fire quickly to take them out, remembering to reload the gun when needed. Keep responding to the robbers as you try to clear the shooting challenge.

pages.title: Pixie Baby Bath
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Pixie Baby Bath follows a fairy baby's morning care routine. Use bath toys while washing her, then change the diaper and dry her hair. Finish by choosing clothing after the bathing and care activities have prepared the pixie for the day.

pages.title: Princy Eye Doctor
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princy Eye Doctor takes Princy to an eye specialist because she is having trouble seeing. Work through the available examination activities to check her vision. Complete the visit by choosing glasses for her after the game's eye-care steps are finished.

pages.title: Soccer Mob
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Soccer Mob has you build a crowd of football supporters representing a chosen nation. Recruit more fans to increase your numbers and challenge other players' groups in real time. Grow the mob as you compete against rival supporters in the soccer-themed contest.

pages.title: Magic Easter Tiles
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Magic Easter Tiles lets you play music by tapping tiles in an Easter-themed setting. Follow the sequence of available tiles and keep selecting them accurately. Build your musical run while trying to avoid mistakes and improve on your previous best score.

pages.title: Bottle Blast
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Bottle Blast is an arcade challenge about smashing bottles with taps. Select the bottles to break them and add to the score as the glass shatters. Keep targeting the available bottles while trying to raise the final total from your attempt.

pages.title: GrowBlon
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: GrowBlon asks you to cover the play area with inflated balloons while enemies move around it. Hold to grow a balloon, then release to leave it in place. Avoid contact with enemies during inflation and fill enough space to meet the goal.

pages.title: Photo Puzzle
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Photo Puzzle challenges you to reconstruct an original image from its separated sections. Study the picture's details and rearrange the available pieces into their correct positions. Continue matching the parts until the complete photograph is restored and the puzzle is solved.

pages.title: Return Man Football
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Return Man Football asks you to carry the ball from the starting area to the touchdown zone. Pick from ten teams and work toward scoring by reaching the green goal area. Keep your play within the rules to avoid losing points.

pages.title: Dont Touch My Fish
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Dont Touch My Fish challenges you to guide a girl carrying her fish without touching the edges. Control her movement carefully as the route continues. Keep away from the boundaries for as long as possible to extend the attempt.

pages.title: Monster Truck Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Monster Truck Coloring Book gives you vehicle pictures to decorate with your chosen colors. Select a monster truck, pick shades with the brush, and fill the different areas of the drawing. Create your own color scheme across the truck illustrations.

pages.title: Super Ellie Saving City
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Super Ellie Saving City prepares Ellie and her puppy companion for a superhero outing. Choose dresses, capes, and a mask for Ellie, then style the dog as well. Save a picture of their finished looks before the pair set off on their mission.

pages.title: Fish Shooter
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Fish Shooter is a colored-ball matching game where you aim shots into the arrangement. Bring together at least three balls sharing a color to remove them and earn points. Choose useful landing positions to keep building the score with each shot.

pages.title: Rack'em 8 Ball Pool
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Rack'em 8 Ball Pool offers head-to-head pool against an online opponent or a friend. Aim your cue-ball shots to pocket balls and work toward winning the eight-ball game. Challenge another player and plan how each shot leaves the table for the next turn.

pages.title: Stick Running
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Stick Running sends a stick figure through a randomly generated side-scrolling course. React to crates, changing floor heights, incoming missiles, and rotating saws. Keep the runner moving past the obstacles to travel farther before a collision ends the attempt.

pages.title: BFF's Going Out Collection
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: BFF's Going Out Collection helps Rapunzel get ready to meet Elsa and Ariel for a night out. Choose outfits for both a street café visit and a trip to the cinema. Put together looks suited to the two stops on the friends' evening.

pages.title: Rich Girls Mall Shopping
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Rich Girls Mall Shopping takes three princesses through the mall's fashion stores. Try different outfits on each character and compare clothing combinations before choosing what to buy. Explore the shops' selections to complete a separate shopping look for every princess.

pages.title: Pregnant Ariel Real Makeover
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Pregnant Ariel Real Makeover brings Ariel to your salon for a confidence-boosting beauty session. Help the expectant princess through the available facial-care and makeup activities. Create a refreshed appearance for her using the salon's makeover choices and styling options.

pages.title: Too Many Bubbles
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Too Many Bubbles challenges you to collect bubbles while moving past obstacles. Guide the character quickly through the available space and keep away from the hazards in the route. Gather as many bubbles as possible before the arcade attempt ends.

pages.title: Berry Jump
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Berry Jump asks you to keep a flying character airborne by tapping the screen. Collect berries during the journey to extend the time you can fly. Keep gathering the fruit as you try to continue the flight for longer.

pages.title: Blitz Tactics
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Blitz Tactics challenges you to capture enemy bases while avoiding direct battles with their troops. Plan movements in real time to reach the objectives without crossing the opposing forces. Choose a route and timing that let you seize each defended position.

pages.title: Antique Village Escape Episode 2
pages.creator: Snapbreak Games AB
pages.description: Antique Village Escape Episode 2 challenges you to find a way out of an old village. Explore its locations, pick up useful objects, and solve the puzzles blocking your progress. Use the inventory and clues to uncover this episode's escape route.

pages.title: Bouncy Ball
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Bouncy Ball combines platforming jumps with basketball scoring. Move the ball between platforms, dodge the obstacles, and reach the hoop to finish the stage. Work through the levels by timing each jump so the route ends in a successful dunk.
